spp.description: Samples per pixel accumulated per frame; the image converges over frames.

maxDepth.description: Maximum number of ray bounces of the path tracer.

aperture.description: Lens aperture of the thin-lens depth of field; 0 is a pinhole camera.

focusPlane.description: Distance of the in-focus plane from the camera, in metres.

russianRoulette.description: Terminate low-contribution paths stochastically to save work.

russianRouletteMinBounces.description: Bounces every path survives before Russian roulette may stop it.

clampIndirect.description: Clamp the peak channel of radiance contributed after the first bounce to this value to suppress fireflies; 0 disables clamping.

lightSampling.description: Debugging switch for direct lighting: 'mis' (default) combines next-event estimation with BSDF sampling using the power heuristic, 'nee' uses only explicit light sampling, 'bsdf' only light seen by BSDF rays.

exposure.description: Scales the radiance before tone mapping.

toneMapper.description: Tone mapping curve: 0 gamma 2.2, 1 sRGB, 2 ACES, 3 PBR Neutral, 4 AgX, 5 Filmic.

bloomIntensity.description: Strength of the HDR bloom glow added before tone mapping; 0 disables bloom.

bloomThreshold.description: Linear radiance threshold above which pixels contribute to bloom.

bloomRadius.description: Bloom gather radius in pixels; at most 144 taps, so the glow stays smooth up to 8.

bloomKnee.description: Soft transition width around the bloom threshold.

exposureEV.description: Photographic exposure offset in stops (multiplies radiance by 2^exposureEV).

whiteBalanceTemp.description: White balance colour temperature in Kelvin (6500 is neutral D65).

whiteBalanceTint.description: Green-magenta white balance tint offset (0 is neutral).

contrast.description: Photographic contrast pivoted around 18% middle grey (1 is neutral).

saturation.description: Colour saturation multiplier (0 is greyscale, 1 is neutral).

cdlSlope.description: ASC CDL slope multiplier (1 is neutral).

cdlOffset.description: ASC CDL additive offset (0 is neutral).

cdlPower.description: ASC CDL power exponent (1 is neutral).

lensDistortionK1.description: Primary radial Brown-Conrady lens distortion coefficient (0 is none).

lensDistortionK2.description: Secondary radial Brown-Conrady lens distortion coefficient (0 is none).

chromaticAberration.description: Radial lateral chromatic aberration: the red and blue channels are sampled at (1 +/- 2 x this) times the pixel radius of green (0 is none).

vignetteStrength.description: Radial edge darkening strength (0 disables vignette).

vignetteSmoothness.description: Exponent controlling the vignette falloff curve.

filmGrain.description: Midtone-weighted film grain standard deviation (0 disables).

sensorReadNoise.description: Additive Gaussian sensor read noise standard deviation (0 disables).

sensorShotNoise.description: Signal-dependent Poisson-Gaussian sensor shot noise scale (0 disables).

noiseSeed.description: Deterministic integer seed for film grain and sensor noise.
